extraction.name: LongBench
extraction.description: The first bilingual, multi-task benchmark for long context understanding. It comprises 21 datasets across 6 task categories in both English and Chinese, with an average length of 6,711 words (English) and 13,386 characters (Chinese). These tasks cover key long-text application areas including single-doc QA, multi-doc QA, summarization, few-shot learning, synthetic tasks, and code completion.
extraction.creator: Yushi Bai, Xin Lv, Jiajie Zhang, Hongchang Lyu, Jiankai Tang, Zhidian Huang, Zhengxiao Du, Xiao Liu, Aohan Zeng, Lei Hou, Yuxiao Dong, Jie Tang, Juanzi Li
extraction.publisher: Tsinghua University, Zhipu.AI, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
extraction.rai:dataCollection: 6 datasets are directly extracted from the original datasets provided by previous studies, 10 are built based on the original datasets and processed to be suitable for long context evaluation, and 5 are created and annotated manually.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Manual Human Curator, Software Collection
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: NarrativeQA, Qasper, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue, DuReader, GovReport, QMSum, MultiNews, VCSUM, TREC, LSHT, SAMSum, TriviaQA, English Wikipedia, C4 Dataset, Github
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: For few-shot learning, randomly select an integer within a range as the number of examples, then randomly sample the corresponding number of samples from the training set, and concatenate them to form the context. For synthetic tasks, randomly sample 30 passages and select one for summarization using GPT-3.5-Turbo. For PassageCount, randomly select passages, repeat, and shuffle. For code completion, shuffle cross-file code snippets and combine them into context.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: All datasets are standardized into a unified format. Data is extracted from test sets of public datasets to avoid test leakage. Two extraction strategies are used: random sampling and uniform sampling. Passages in TriviaQA with less than 1,000 words are filtered out. Complete Wikipedia passages are utilized for multi-doc QA, and passages are randomly ordered.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: For MultiFieldQA, three Ph.D. students annotate the question and answer for each article, ensuring answers can be inferred from the documents and evidence placement is fairly random. For PassageRetrieval, GPT-3.5-Turbo is used to summarize one of the sampled passages.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Cross-validation among annotators shows a 100% accuracy rate of the annotated answers for MultiFieldQA.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Ph.D. students with extensive research experience in the field of NLP
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Potential bias regarding the placement of evidence (mitigated by ensuring random placement). Memorization bias exists for datasets derived from Wikipedia (HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MusiQue) as they are common training sources for LLMs.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Potentially unreliable automatic metrics (ROUGE-L, F1) which may not accurately reflect response quality, especially for models generating longer responses. Coupling with instruction-following capabilities, as tasks demand a certain level of instruction-following capability.
